question: Does the version 1.3 installed GFx opener still resolve supplied filenames through the type-11 File Data registry before CcGFXStream creates a movie instance?

scope.boundary: This packet proves the static filename-specific opener chain and records bounded exact-name title observations. It does not generalize those observations to other filenames or frames.

runtimeEvidence.qualification: The records are exact-name, bounded observations from the title/menu sessions. Dynamic descriptor, resource, image, and output pointers are not stable identities, and no claim is made for unfiltered requests.

guards: Do not generalize the recorded exact-name type-11 cache observations to other filenames or sessions.
